_: Reef & Seek's remote configuration. "play" is read by the page (game/index.html in the ReefSeek repo) before it calls the rankings server at /reef: only the exact value true switches the Daily Reef ranking and the weekly tournament on (RS-034, 18 November 2026); missing or false, the game never calls the server. The rest is read once at launch by the app (android/app/src/main/java/com/voltixstudios/reefseek/Config.java in the ReefSeek repo; Ads.java names the six placements). A placement shows advertising only when it is true AND its unit is an AdMob ad unit id. A debug build, and a release built without the game's own AdMob app id in ADMOB_APP_ID (the closed-test build, RS-031), ignore this file and use Google's test units with every placement on. Turning one on or off is an edit here and a push, not an app update. Nothing in this file can change a price, a reward or a rule. 18 November 2026: every unit is Google's demo unit (rewarded ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/5224354917, interstitial ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/1033173712) while the AdMob account is suspended (until about 14 December 2026, R-73) and the game is in closed testing, so no tester can produce invalid traffic. Reef & Seek has no AdMob app and no real ad units yet: none is named anywhere in the game's repository. Before production, create the app and its six units (continue, hint, freeze, double, past rewarded; inter interstitial), put the app id in ADMOB_APP_ID, and put the real units here. 20 November 2026: "play" is false at Sr. Orra's request, to take the rankings off the D1 database they share with Voltix Analytics, which was answering "D1 DB is overloaded"; the game hides its Tournament tab as well.
